_meta.description: Trigger phrase patterns for .claude/hooks/workflow-trigger.js (#2816). Adding or widening a trigger phrase is a data edit here, matching the policy 02-github-workflow.md already states for trigger-flag-allowlist.json: recognized flags are data, not a hook edit. Patterns moved; meanings did not.
_meta.consumer: .claude/hooks/workflow-trigger.js — compiled once per invocation, before the fast-path check
_meta.compositionDecision: Patterns are data; COMPOSITION IS NOT. reviewTrigger, analysisMatch and testPlanApprovalTrigger are conjunctions of a pattern, a co-requirement and exclusions against sibling triggers, and those relationships stay in code. See Construction/Design-Decisions/2026-09-07-trigger-patterns-composition-stays-in-code.md for the rejected `requires`/`excludes` schema.

workflowTriggerPrefix.description: Trigger prefixes routed to /bug, /enhancement and /proposal. The captured group is the trigger type.

workTrigger.description: Any prompt starting with 'work '. Deliberately broad — the issue number or status filter is extracted opportunistically afterwards.

doneTrigger.description: Standalone 'done' or 'done #N' at message start. Contextual detection (are there active issues) happens later.

reviewAtStart.description: Anchored at the start so assistant output mentioning a review command does not re-trigger routing.

strictIssueRef.description: An EXPLICIT issue reference. Required by triggers that mutate or route to a command, where picking up a stray conversational number would be costly.

looseIssueRef.description: Also accepts a bare two-or-more-digit number. Used ONLY by the analysis trigger, which is read-only, so a false positive costs a STOP reminder rather than an action. Deliberately distinct from strictIssueRef — collapsing the two would change what routes.

approvalVerb.description: Approval verb for the verbal test-plan approval trigger (#2815). Never sufficient alone.

testPlanRef.description: Explicit test-plan reference, hyphenated or spaced, singular or plural.

refreshFlag.description: Cache-refresh flag on the commands help path.
